name: 5-methyl-MDA
summary: 5-Methyl-MDA, also known as 5-methyl-3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine, is an entactogen and psychedelic designer drug of the amphetamine class. It is a ring-methylated homologue of MDA and a structural isomer of MDMA.

pharmacology.text: 5-Methyl-MDA acts as a selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA) with IC50 values of 107nM, 11,600nM, and 1,494nM for serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine release, respectively. 2-methyl-MDA and 5-methyl-MDA have been used to help guide computer modelling of the serotonin transporter complex.

uses.text: 5-Methyl-MDA, also known as 5-methyl-3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine, is an entactogen and psychedelic designer drug of the amphetamine class.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: It has exactly the same atoms as MDMA, C11H15NO2, but the extra methyl group sits on the ring instead of on the nitrogen, which changes it from a balanced releaser into a mainly serotonin-releasing drug.
fact.zh: 它的原子組成與MDMA完全相同（C11H15NO2），只是多出的甲基接在環上而不是氮上；這個差別讓它從均衡型的釋放劑變成主要釋放血清素的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它的原子组成与MDMA完全相同（C11H15NO2），只是多出的甲基接在环上而不是氮上；这个差别让它从均衡型的释放剂变成主要释放血清素的药物。
